run_mjwarp_viewer: run the mjwarp-viewer CLI to load and simulate an MJCF file with MuJoCo Warp
run_passive_viewer: run a passive mujoco viewer with a step function that syncs simulation state to the display
run_viser_viewer: run a viser-based web viewer for MuJoCo Warp simulation with a custom step function
compile_warp_step: compile a physics step as a CUDA graph for optimized MuJoCo Warp simulation
make_warp_step_fn: create a warp step function that copies data to GPU arrays and launches the simulation step
